facts.big: there is / there are · present simple
facts.label: There is/are e hábitos
facts.sub: Use there is para um e there are para vários: There are ten newspapers. Use o present simple para hábitos: I usually read the news.

facts.label: Um
facts.sub: Use there is para uma coisa: There is a big table. There is a puzzle. Na fala, use there’s: There’s a free seat. Para negar, use there is no ou there isn’t.

facts.label: Vários
facts.sub: Use there are para várias coisas: There are ten newspapers. There are photos. Para perguntar, comece com are: Are there many newspapers?

pages.title: A quiet library · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Monday morning in a quiet library in Seattle. Gray light comes through the tall windows. Clara sits at a wooden table with a newspaper. Her friend Henry comes in with a cup of coffee. He sees the newspaper in her hands. He asks about it.
“Clara, do you read the newspaper every day?” says Henry. “Yes, I read it in the library. There is a big table near the window.” says Clara. “Are there many newspapers here?” says Henry.
